### Be Strong and Courageous - The Crosswalk Devotional - July 19
Author: Amanda Idleman
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/be-strong-and-courageous-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Joshua 1:9
Points:
- God's command to Joshua acknowledged his human weakness and addressed his inner fears.
- Entering into God's promises requires stepping into the unfamiliar before seeing the outcome.
- The Lord never guarantees an easy path, but He promises His continuous presence.
- God calls believers to character and faithful obedience rather than worldly measures of success.

### Stepping Forward in Faith as One Chapter Comes to a Close
Author: Amber Ginter
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/stepping-forward-in-faith-as-one-chapter-comes-to-a-close.html
Passage: Joshua 1:9
Points:
- Major transitions are intimidating and demand trusting God without having the full picture.
- God reassures His people with the promise of His presence rather than a detailed blueprint.
- Embracing new chapters involves grieving what is left behind and overcoming the fear of the unknown.
- Strength and courage develop by taking one obedient step at a time instead of worrying about the future.
